gates.description: OpenAPI specification must be valid and parseable — every endpoint must appear in the spec
Every API endpoint must have a description, request schema, response schema, and at least one example
Authentication flow must be documented with step-by-step guide and token/key management instructions
Every error code the API returns must be documented with cause and resolution steps
Code examples must be provided in at least the top languages used by the developer audience
API changelog must be updated with every release — breaking changes must be clearly marked

anti_patterns.description: Shipping an API endpoint without documentation — developers find it via trial-and-error or source code
Generating OpenAPI spec from code comments that developers copy-pasted without reviewing — spec is stale on day one
Code examples that no longer work because the API changed — the most damaging form of documentation rot
Authentication flow buried in FAQs and forum posts — the first thing a developer hits and the most confusing
API returns error code 4023 with no documentation — developer must file a support ticket to understand why

escalation_triggers: API breaking change shipped without documentation update or migration guide
OpenAPI spec systematically out of sync with production API — cannot be trusted
Authentication documentation so confusing that support tickets dominate developer onboarding
Code examples consistently failing due to API changes engineering will not re-test
New API surface too large to document before launch with current resources
Localization requirement for API docs in new market with no process established

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with API endpoint definitions and authentication requirements

output_certifications: Valid OpenAPI specification covering every endpoint
Every endpoint has description, request schema, response schema, and example
Authentication flow documented with step-by-step guide
Every error code documented with cause and resolution
Code examples provided in at least curl and one primary SDK language
API changelog updated and breaking changes clearly marked
